Latin word

postrēmō

adverb; closing a series: prīmum … deinde … postrēmō · Wiktionary

lastly, finally; in the end

In this lexicon

  • finally

    the recommended word · classical · Cic. Fam. 15.14.2: prīmum … deinde … tum … postrēmō; Tac. Agr. 3.1: prīmō … postrēmō

Examples

  • invīsa prīmō dēsidia postrēmō amātur

    idleness, hateful at first, is loved in the endTac. Agr. 3.1

    In the entry for finally

  • prīmum ut tē … tantō intervallō vidērem, deinde ut tibi … possem praesēns grātulārī, … postrēmō ut amīcitia nostra … cōnfirmārētur vehementius

    first, to see you after so long; then, to congratulate you in person; … and finally, to make our friendship strongerCic. Fam. 15.14.2

    In the entry for finally
